_upcoming_2026-11-10: Fractured Skies (CCP news 'Fractured Skies in Focus', screenshots 2026-10-28): from 10 Nov each empire runs a two-month MILITARY CAMPAIGN to find ancient (Drifter) artifacts; ANY capsuleer can contribute, Factional Warfare enlistment NOT required. Races: Amarr vs Minmatar, Caldari vs Gallente (pick a side). Conquests start February. Also: refreshed AIR Career Program (current progress resets 10 Nov: claim rewards first), dozens of level 1 missions reworked, free pre-fitted AIR Academy ships for NEW pilots, four navy attack battlecruisers incl. Naga, nine Synchronizer Rigs, EVE Vanguard 24/7. Campaign rewards and tasks not published yet: add as a program with reward_isk once seen in game; until then not routed. MORE (screenshots 2026-10-28): four objectives per campaign, all in Factional Warfare space (mostly LOW-SEC: route only with a fit that passes the 99% rule): hack containers, destroy NPC (non-capsuleer) forces, damage enemy capsuleers (PvP: never routed), mine ore. They drop faction campaign items; deliver them to item traders in your empire's HEADQUARTERS system for ISK + LP per delivery. Traders also sell exclusive rewards (new Glamourex booster, faction salvager module, scanning-upgrade blueprints, apparel). New achievements/titles give Penumbral SKINs. Objective bonuses (warp speed, defense, damage) activate 5 Jan until the February Conquest. Mid-January live event in low-sec. Winning faction gets a limited Drifter module in its LP store (LP value may jump). Model on launch: ISK+LP per delivered item x items per minute for hacking / NPC kills / mining. NAVY ATTACK BATTLECRUISERS (screenshots 2026-10-28): Naga Navy Issue (now cruise missiles + torpedoes, 6 launchers, extra mid), Tornado Fleet Issue (projectile rate of fire, extra mid, MWD signature), Oracle Navy Issue (extra low + utility high), Talos Navy Issue (hybrid damage, armor plate). Glass cannons for FW low-sec; not for this character yet (battlecruiser skills). Market angle: a missile Naga may raise demand for cruise/torpedo launchers and ammo around launch; watch prices, do not pre-buy on a guess. Navy attack BCs: ONLY from Factional Warfare LP stores. SYNCHRONIZER RIGS (screenshots 2026-10-28): new rig type, 9 sets x 3 sizes (4 empire + 5 pirate); bonus +1% per matching faction module fitted. Empire synchronizer BPCs only in each empire's FW LP store; Angel/Guristas in Insurgency LP stores; Blood/Sansha/Serpentis in the pirate LP stores. BUILD INPUTS: the Tech I SALVAGE materials of the rigs they boost + components; Amarr/Caldari/Minmatar components come mainly from LOW-CLASS WORMHOLE content, Gallente from ROGUE DRONE components; pirate rigs are built from empire synchronizers. MARKET ANGLE: demand for T1 salvage and rogue drone components should rise after 10 Nov -> salvaging (an activity we can do) and holding salvage instead of dumping it may pay more; compare prices before/after launch. EVE Vanguard (FPS) runs 24/7 and feeds the campaigns (not playable here). CAMPAIGN SITES (screenshots 2026-10-28): EVE Vanguard players' contracts spawn special campaign ANOMALIES in HIGH-SEC and low-sec (PvE, mining, exploration), with more campaign items than normal sites; they vanish quickly. Run them for their own rewards or hand the items in. HIGH-SEC ones are the realistic target for this character: on launch, scan the anomaly list (probe scanner) in nearby high-sec and record one site's type, items and time, so it can be ranked by ISK/min (items x ISK+LP per delivery). Vanguard itself needs Founder's Access (separate purchase): out of scope. NEW HUD (opt-in Feature Preview): a capacitor gauge shows how fast cap is gained or lost -> after fitting, read that rate and tell Claude (it calibrates combatcheck's capacitor model). AIR ACADEMY SHIPS: 13 free pre-fitted ships (combat, exploration, mining; e.g. Academy Merlin 'recommended for Level 1 Security Missions and Combat Anomalies') but ONLY inside Exordium starter space, not reprocessable, swap free at Exordium stations: no use from Jita unless this character can still enter Exordium (check in game once; if yes, a free L1 combat ship would skip the ~98k fit). AIR Career Program moves into Achievements (~80 new achievements); milestones become achievements.
